body.title: Why a starter, not from scratch

body.text: Agents can build any element from scratch. It takes professional expertise, time and money.
A starter is different. It is not a ready solution for your case but a tool that gives a working MVP at once. You quickly see what is worth growing and what to drop.

items: The project's agent notices a task no element solves.
The Fractera store proposes a starter and says why it fits.
You decide: nothing is bought without your payment window.
The core installs the starter as a new element that serves every element of the project.

body.text: Starters are tools for a fast start, not ready solutions for every case.
Fractera does not guarantee that a starter closes your task completely. Before buying, study the starter's page and the check report that comes with it.
A bought starter is yours. Push it to your own GitHub repository and keep growing it.
Once you have improved it a lot, you can sell it through the Fractera marketplace.
